notes.title: Bug fixes and gameplay difficulty normalization.
notes.content:
This patch addresses the following

[list]
[*] Zipline bug, where the zipline handle was not returning to original position.
Now when the player respawns or reaches the zipline start point, the grab handle is there again.

[*] Level changes to ease the game play

[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Zipline bug, where the zipline handle was not returning to original position.
Now when the player respawns or reaches the zipline start point, the grab handle is there again.

notes.title: This Patch includes quality of life improvements
notes.content:
This Patch includes quality of life improvements.
There is now a "Controls" button in Start and Pause Menu, which will enable players to see the Keyboard/Mouse as well as Gamepad controller key mappings.
